title: Nexora SAGE Atlas Artifact
description: JSON Schema contract for the Atlas artifact produced by AST Sequencers and Orchestrators.

store_hook_selector_evidence.description: Direct store((state) => state.member) syntax in an indexed callable, lexically bound to a same-file exported variable or exact named import. Optional direct_return_form records only a direct return statement or concise arrow expression; optional selected_result_direct_calls record direct calls of a const-bound selector result. Neither subscription nor execution is established.

same_file_store_action_call_evidence.description: Direct store.getState().action() or const { action } = store.getState(); action() syntax in an indexed callable, lexically bound to a same-file exported variable or exact named import. No module resolution, execution or runtime state-flow claim.

import_call_evidence.description: Single-file lexical import binding of call syntax. No module resolution, type safety or execution claim.

imported_property_event_call_evidence.description: Checker-bound named-import value.property.emit/on/once/off/addListener/removeListener literal call syntax in one indexed callable. The imported value's runtime owner and event delivery remain unknown.

factory_source_evidence.description: Positive single-file source syntax: an exported const directly calls a local factory or passes it to a wrapper, and that factory has one direct named-import constructor return. No callback execution, package condition, instance identity or field immutability claim.

same_file_direct_call_evidence.description: Bounded direct identifier call syntax linked by the TypeScript checker to one top-level same-file callable declaration. No alias, nested call, type or runtime claim.

class_instance_event_call_evidence.description: Literal event-call syntax through a readonly class field directly initialized from one named import. Runtime instance ownership, delivery and callback execution are not established.

class_event_emitter_field_evidence.description: Direct node:events EventEmitter class-field constructor and literal this.field call syntax in direct methods or lexical arrow callbacks. Public field writes, runtime instance identity, listener delivery and external property callers are not established.

event_emitter_singleton_evidence.description: Direct exported variable initialized with a lexically bound node:events EventEmitter constructor; no runtime identity or event delivery claim.

zustand_setter_call_evidence.description: A supported direct or curried Zustand factory callback parameter is lexically called inside one indexed action body, optionally through an exact persist import. Syntax only; no runtime transition or call-result ownership claim.

literal_key_evidence.description: Only top-level identifier or string-literal keys of the direct object first argument. Unavailable is not absence of a state write.

structure.description: Nested object representing the directory structure.

initializer_member_evidence.description: Parser-owned variable-initializer syntax candidates, not class members or proven call-result properties. Never implies runtime or lexical binding.

resolved_module_importer_index.description: Optional snapshot-local lookup acceleration; callers still validate import records, parser evidence and both source endpoints.

symbols.description: Collision-preserving global symbol occurrence registry. Symbol names are not unique identities; file and source span provide scope.
